Does not modify frozen registry/registry_index.json, run_card.json, or experiment_state.json.

static_holdout_comparison.methodology_warning: Static rasters built on the full existing_faults.tif catalogue are evaluated as-is on gems57-pooled-hide-v2 (seeds 20 & 30). Any candidate whose geometry positively tracks full-catalogue fault tips/strands leaks hidden-component locations into static scoring: for example, H79-NHR scores 0.1431 / 0.1522 in true blind out-of-fold refitting vs higher when its full-catalogue static map is scored without re-hiding geometry. Static numbers below are comparative diagnostics ONLY, never blind out-of-fold HOLDOUT-DTI claims.
